name: Local Sites
description: One-click local preview for your web projects: detects Next.js, Vite, Astro, Nuxt, SvelteKit, PHP, static sites and WordPress plugins, starts them in a visible Orca terminal, shows logs and errors, and opens the site in your default browser.

cover.alt: The Local Sites panel in Orca's sidebar: three web projects with status, start and stop buttons, an Open in browser button and an errors list

screenshots.alt: Three projects in the panel: one running with a compile error, one stopped, one failed with a port conflict
screenshots.caption: Start, stop and see errors at a glance

screenshots.alt: Four checkmarks: reads workspaces and terminal output, runs one command in its own terminal, opens only localhost after a click, no requests of its own
screenshots.caption: Why Full access? Local only, no tracking
